Name: Handie's Beard for Fashion Sense
Author: TheBlackHand13
Description:
[i][b]New in v.1.0.1: [/b]All vanilla beards have been added for your convenience[/i]


I have a lot of characters, and a lot of characters with beards. Some of them are also elves. Turns out my Fashion Sense elf ear mod overwrites the vanilla beard - and there are legitimately no beards for Fashion Sense.
So I scrapped this mod together and thought I might as well share it here on Nexus.

Simply pick up the hand mirror from Pierre if you didn't already have it and you're good to go.

[u][b]EDIT 9/7/2025
[/b][/u]In case there's any chance you might be confused how to use this mod for some reason;
- I've put these beards in the Accessories slot of the hand mirror. This mod does not make it so that if you select a beard in character creation, it will continue to show after adding cosmetics with the Hand Mirror. Most content packs for FS make the default beards disappear--THIS MOD IS A WORKAROUND TO THAT ISSUE. If you try to use the default beard selection when initially creating your character, that beard will still disappear if you apply FS content later.

- to use this mod, open the character editor with the Hand Mirror and find the beards in the Accessories slot. If you want to use multiple accessories, that's what the multiple layers option is for. Pick your beard accessory, then select a new layer to pick another accessory, etc...

[b]Features:[/b]
[s]- one beard for FS (maybe more in the future)
[/s]- all the vanilla beards



Requirements:

- SMAPI, probably
- Fashion Sense and all its dependencies

I may consider adding more cosmetic items if there is interest (or if I just happen to want to make more) - hit me up in the comments if you like
